result.notes: Waterfall.io has a real REST API (docs.waterfall.io/v1) with ~13 documented endpoints (prospecting, contact/company enrichment, email verification, job-change detection) authenticated via a static x-api-key header — no OAuth. However there is no self-serve signup or public pricing/dashboard: the marketing site and pricing page repeatedly funnel prospects to \"Book a Call\", run a free data benchmark, then issue a custom usage-based quote before any API key is provisioned. This is sales/partner-gated access rather than a dev-portal signup, so despite having a normal REST+API-key surface, it is not buildable today without a sales relationship. MCP registry hints (waterfallbridge, mcp-email-waterfall-orchestrator) do not appear to reference this company's contact-intel product — likely false-positive name collisions with unrelated \"waterfall\" (e.g., email-waterfall routing) tools — so mcp.status is reported as none rather than community.
result.one_liner: Waterfall.io is a B2B contact/company data platform that aggregates 30+ data vendors to provide prospecting, contact enrichment, and email verification via API.
